paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The plot displays three lines representing different accuracy metrics—Final Accuracy (blue solid line with circular markers), Δ Accuracy (orange dashed line with diamond markers), and Initial Accuracy (green dashed line with square markers)—plotted against Initial Confidence on the x-axis, which ranges from 0.95 to 0.99 on a linear scale with tick marks at 0.01 intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The blue line (Final Acc) starts at approximately 0.85 at Initial Confidence 0.95 and increases slightly to about 0.88 at 0.99, with error bars indicating variability. The orange line (Δ Acc) begins at about 0.88 at 0.95 and gradually decreases to approximately 0.75 at 0.99, also with error bars. The green line (Initial Acc) remains near 0.0 across the entire range, rising slightly to about 0.1 at 0.99, and has small error bars. All lines show small fluctuations, and the plot includes a legend in the upper right corner identifying each line.
